newsitem.title: USA: Zytec to increase development operations.
newsitem.headline: Zytec to increase development operations.

text.p: Zytec Corp said Tuesday a significant increase in new power supply project wins from its internetworking customers was causing it to expand engineering development operations in both Austria and Colorado.

"As previously reported, we had a record 16 new project wins in our first quarter, compared with 20 in all of 1996 and 16 in 1995," Ronald Schmidt, chief executive of the electronic power conversion equipment maker. "Based on these results and our current bidding activity, it would appear that Zytec's project win rate has increased by about 50 percent on an annualized basis and, therefore, demands an expansion of our engineering capacity."
Zytec said it would establishing a new engineering development department at our Broomfield, Colo. facility, and we are expanding the existing one at our European headquarters in Vienna, Austria.
Zytec sahres closed up 5/16 at 14-11/16 Tuesday.
